name: Ixchel
prompt: Edit ONLY the TOP CENTRE fitting of Ixchel's headdress in this existing illustration. It currently resembles a second carved snake head with eyes/mouth, above her left jaguar ear near upper centre. Replace that fitting completely with a simple FLAT RECTANGULAR JADE TABLET: straight geometric edges, plain uncarved jade surface, NO eyes, NO mouth, NO nose, NO face, NO snout, NO animal features and no lettering. Preserve EXACTLY ONE living snake HEAD at UPPER RIGHT with tongue and eyes, and preserve the coiled serpent BODY around the headdress. Ensure there is no other serpent head anywhere, including carved or symbolic heads. Leave all other anatomy and composition intact: aged jaguar-eared/fanged woman, two clawed hands, opaque crossed-bone skirt, inverted water jar and enormous pouring torrent, storm landscape. Respectful awe-inspiring Maya goddess. Source ixchel-c08 entwined serpent headdress. No text, watermark, extra limbs, aura or gore. Square premium painterly cinematic image.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and head, jar, hand, chest and skirt crops. An aged, wrinkled goddess with spotted skin, two spotted jaguar ears and two small fangs (ixchel-c04/c18), and two hands ending in long dark claws instead of nails (c08). The entwined serpent headdress (c08) has exactly ONE live snake head (upper right, forked tongue); the former top-centre fitting is now a plain, faceless jade tablet. A woven skirt carries a large crossed-bones motif (c08). She inverts a huge painted water jar, and a massive physical torrent pours out under driving rain (Goddess O/rain-deity jar iconography, c10), with a monumental low angle over stormy Maya forest, temple and waterfalls. The jar fret/scroll ornament and the skirt band are abstract patterns, not legible or pseudo text. Heavy bead collars, the jar and the cloth cover the torso, so there is no nudity. Awe-inspiring, not cute, and not a copy of the Smite or Apocalypto designs (c20/c21).
